verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that SigNoz can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux), letting you 'keep full control of your data plane'. That implies ownership of stored telemetry, but the pack never documents retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings per signal (traces/logs/metrics), explicit data deletion/purge capability, retention controls for SigNoz Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.
